<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option('blogname', 'Demo Shop');
update_option('blogdescription', 'Fictional products. A cart experiment.');
update_option('woocommerce_currency', 'USD');
update_option('woocommerce_price_num_decimals', 2);
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_enable_ajax_add_to_cart', 'yes');
update_option('woocommerce_cart_redirect_after_add', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_allow_tracking', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_show_marketplace_suggestions', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array('skipped' => true));
update_option('woocommerce_task_list_hidden', 'yes');
WC_Install::create_pages();
foreach (array(array('Blue Mug', '12.00', 'blue-mug'), array('Notebook', '8.00', 'notebook'), array('Desk Lamp', '24.00', 'desk-lamp')) as $data) {
    if (wc_get_product_id_by_sku('demo-' . $data[2])) { continue; }
    $product = new WC_Product_Simple();
    $product->set_name($data[0]);
    $product->set_slug($data[2]);
    $product->set_sku('demo-' . $data[2]);
    $product->set_regular_price($data[1]);
    $product->set_virtual(true);
    $product->set_status('publish');
    $product->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
    $product->set_description('A fictional demonstration product. No purchase necessary.');
    $product->save();
}
$menu = wp_create_nav_menu('Demo navigation');
if (!is_wp_error($menu)) {
    foreach (array('shop', 'cart') as $page) {
        $id = wc_get_page_id($page);
        wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu, 0, array('menu-item-title' => ucfirst($page), 'menu-item-object-id' => $id, 'menu-item-object' => 'page', 'menu-item-type' => 'post_type', 'menu-item-status' => 'publish'));
    }
    set_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations', array('primary' => $menu, 'handheld' => $menu));
}
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');
flush_rewrite_rules();
